title.value: An Act concerning Environment - Playground Surfacing Materials - Prohibitions
title.provenance: A BILL ENTITLED AN ACT concerning 1 Environment - Playground Surfacing Materials - Prohibitions 2

location.provenance: BY adding to Article - Environment Section 6-16A-01 through 6-16A-05 to be under the new subtitle 'Subtitle 16A. Playground Surfacing Materials' - Annotated Code of Maryland (2013 Replacement Volume and 2023 Supplement)

reference.provenance: 4lr1508 Introduced and read first time: February 7, 2024 Assigned to: Environment and Transportation

status.provenance: BY adding to Article - Environment Section 6-16A-01 through 6-16A-05 to be under the new subtitle 'Subtitle 16A. Playground Surfacing Materials' - Annotated Code of Maryland (2013 Replacement Volume and 2023 Supplement)

date.provenance: SECTION 2. AND BE IT FURTHER ENACTED, That this Act shall take effect October 1, 2024.

pfas_definition.provenance: PFAS MEANS PER- AND POLYFLUOROALKYL SUBSTANCES.

type.provenance: ON OR AFTER OCTOBER 1, 2024, A PERSON MAY NOT USE, SUPPLY, SELL, SOLICIT, OR OFFER FOR SALE IN THE STATE PLAYGROUND SURFACING MATERIALS THAT CONTAIN: (2) FLUORINATED ORGANIC CHEMICALS THAT CONTAIN AT LEAST 1 FULLY FLUORINATED CARBON ATOM, INCLUDING PFAS SUBSTANCES;

who.provenance: A MANUFACTURER THAT MANUFACTURES, SELLS, OFFERS FOR SALE, OR DISTRIBUTES FOR USE IN THE STATE PLAYGROUND SURFACING MATERIALS SHALL ESTABLISH A CERTIFICATE OF COMPLIANCE

action.provenance: A PERSON MAY NOT USE, SUPPLY, SELL, SOLICIT, OR OFFER FOR SALE IN THE STATE PLAYGROUND SURFACING MATERIALS THAT CONTAIN: (2) FLUORINATED ORGANIC CHEMICALS THAT CONTAIN AT LEAST 1 FULLY FLUORINATED CARBON ATOM, INCLUDING PFAS SUBSTANCES;

products.provenance: PLAYGROUND SURFACING MATERIALS' MEANS PRODUCTS, MATERIALS, OR SUBSTANCES USED OR INSTALLED ON THE GROUND SURFACE OF A PLAYGROUND IN THE STATE.

intentionally_added.provenance: FLUORINATED ORGANIC CHEMICALS THAT CONTAIN AT LEAST 1 FULLY FLUORINATED CARBON ATOM, INCLUDING PFAS SUBSTANCES
